ECSE 4420/6420.attendance: Attendance is not mandatory but highly recommended; every 3 inexcusable classes missed lowers the grade by 2.5%; participation is encouraged but not assessed.
ECSE 4420/6420.lateWork: Missing or late presentations and reports receive zero credit; hard copies of homework and project reports are due before lecture on the due date.
ECSE 4420/6420.makeups: No makeup for the midterm and finals, including demo presentations; makeups only under exceptional circumstances with prior arrangement, and the instructor may deny them.
